sukha.bio: Toronto-born Canadian rapper, singer and songwriter Sukha, born Sukhman Sodhi, is part of the new generation of Punjabi hip-hop crossing between Canada and India. After breaking out with Siftaan and Same Thing, he expanded his audience with the UNDISPUTED EP, collaborations with artists including AR Paisley and Tegi Pannu and two Juno nominations in 2025.

ntwali.bio: Edmonton-based rapper Ntwali Kayijaho came to Canada from Rwanda with his family as a child and uses hip-hop to explore identity, self-growth, activism and his Rwandan heritage. His independent catalogue includes In Full Bloom, Vivid Dreams & Intuitions and the 2025 album New Beginnings.

sarah swire.bio: Ottawa-born Canadian actor, choreographer, singer-songwriter and musician Sarah Swire works across film, television, theatre and music. After training at the Royal Conservatoire of Scotland, she performed and toured internationally while building screen credits including Anna and the Apocalypse, The Boys and Murdoch Mysteries, and she also records music as Sister Swire.
